benefits.heading: Comprehensive Coverage

benefits.heading: Tax Benefits
benefits.text: If you are paying your premiums for comprehensive health insurance plans, then you are eligible for a tax deduction under Section 80D. According to the Income Tax Section 80D, a minimum of ₹50,000 deduction is available for senior citizens and a ₹25,000 tax deduction for non-senior citizens in each financial year.

Your insurance company will give you coverage for this.
